children: Curaleaf offered Aurora shareholders a 45% premium via a US$4.00 per-share tender offer combining cash and Curaleaf shares.
Offer: 0.3463 Curaleaf shares plus US$0.75 cash per Aurora share, implying US$4.00 based on Aug 10, 2026 VWAP.
Value proposition: 45% premium to 30-day VWAP and continued ownership in combined global cannabis platform.
Scale: Combined company would report ~US$1.5B LTM revenue and ~US$350M LTM adjusted EBITDA (as of June 30, 2026).
Synergies: At least US$40M of expected annual cost synergies from the combination.
Tender deadline: Aurora shareholders must tender before December 1, 2026; Curaleaf says Aurora declined engagement.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Curaleaf offers to acquire Aurora with US$4.00 per share deal implying 45% premium and $40M synergies
